legacyPolicy: Preserve existing qualified legacy routes and all refusal guards; prioritize new qualification on Blender 5.3. This tracker does not change source/runtime admission.
priorityBasis: Qualitative engineering dependency/workflow judgments, not user telemetry, numeric popularity scores, guaranteed EEVEE viability or support promotion. Only the three official demo observations are actual scene-use evidence.

typed-field-contracts.label: Typed field and precision contracts
typed-field-contracts.rationale: Scalar/vector/color/Boolean/Integer conversion, staged arithmetic, bounded validation and constant-versus-field execution unlock composed factors, selectors and procedural kernels. Existing supported operations are reused, not re-ported.

image-sampling-lod.label: Image sampling, storage and LOD contracts
image-sampling-lod.rationale: Native alpha/color association, coordinate/filter/mip/LOD behavior, publication pins and cache ownership underpin image-driven normals and fields. Existing evidence is not assumed to cover arbitrary minification.

normal-function-sampling.label: Normal and re-evaluable Height sampling
normal-function-sampling.rationale: Bounded Height functions with native derivative scope unlock image/Noise-to-Bump and composed Normal/Coat Normal. Original Cube and Mandelbrot show channel blockers; these are not gaps in the ShaderNodeNormal class alone. Earn EEVEE first.

material-channel-routing.label: Material channel routing and engine-preserving fallback
material-channel-routing.rationale: Per-channel fidelity, portable carriers and renderer markers must be paired with truthful source-engine-preserving bake intent. Original Cube Cycles refusals are an acceptance target; an EEVEE override is not Cycles parity.

bounded-graph-execution.label: Bounded graph execution and time
bounded-graph-execution.rationale: Typed Switch/Menu/Index and bounded Repeat state with explicit iteration/cost caps unlock composition. Qualify static Repeat before authored animation. Mandelbrot has both tree-animation and unported Repeat blockers.

coordinate-procedural-fields.label: Coordinate and procedural field contracts
coordinate-procedural-fields.rationale: Actual owner/UV/Generated coordinates and bounded field precision enable reusable procedural composition. The official Radial demo is one observed target, not a popularity estimate; useful Voronoi/Noise domains share this foundation.

compositor-domain-algebra.label: Compositor domain algebra and intermediate resampling
compositor-domain-algebra.rationale: Finite data/display windows, origins, extent priority, broadcast and intermediate resampling let spatial operations feed Mix, Alpha Over and filters. This is a dependency/workflow heuristic, not demand demonstrated by the three demos.

compositor-pass-sources.label: Compositor pass sources and camera/encoding contracts
compositor-pass-sources.rationale: Image/Alpha/Depth/Normal pass and camera/encoding contracts enable later Z Combine, Defocus and Vector Blur consumers. This is an engineering inference, not a corpus-observed demand ranking.

compositor-neighborhood-kernels.label: Compositor neighborhood and footprint kernels
compositor-neighborhood-kernels.rationale: Reusable separable/footprint/cache contracts enable variable or relative Blur, Dilate/Erode and remaining Glare domains. Workflow value is inferred; no scene-frequency claim is made.
